title: Private jet charter in Latin America and the Caribbean
description: Private flights in Latin America and the Caribbean: Mexico City, São Paulo, Buenos Aires and Nassau, with airport rules from official sources.
eyebrow: Region · Latin America and the Caribbean
h1: Private flights in Latin America and the Caribbean
lead: From Mexico City to Buenos Aires and the islands of The Bahamas, each country sets its own rules for private flights. Our guides start with the main gateways.

p: Each country in the region has its own permit for charter flights, and some main airports limit private flights. Mexico City's international airport, for example, is closed to them, and private jets use Toluca instead. The operator applies for each permit; we plan the routing and the airports with it before you see a quote.
Our city guides cover Mexico City, São Paulo, Buenos Aires and Nassau. More follow, each checked against official sources before it is published.

sections.h: Planning a trip in the region
p: Many trips in Latin America and the Caribbean combine a business city with a coast or an island. Each country has its own rules for foreign aircraft: some ask for a permit for every charter, and some main airports limit private flights or set hours for them. We plan the routing with the operator, check that every airport on it can take your aircraft at your times, and show you the plan with the quote.
Many travellers combine São Paulo or Mexico City with time on the coast or in The Bahamas; we plan such trips as one journey with one operator where the aircraft and permits allow.
Your broker stays with you from the first enquiry to the last landing, and follows up after the trip.

We are a broker, not an airline, and we have no fixed routes. Tell us where you want to go and when, and we find aircraft from licensed operators, check each operator and name it in your quote before you confirm. Any aircraft, any route, upon availability.
